## Area 🧭

- [ ] Pipeline (runner, data preparation, analysis)
- [ ] Audit UI (label audit, error analysis)
- [ ] Tooling (Makefile, CI, Docker)
- [ ] Other

## Problem

What is missing or hard to do today?

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you want to happen. Name the command, option or output if you can.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked this is not already requested in another issue
- [ ] The change fits the project's scope: a research experiment, not a production scanner (no CI integration, dynamic sandboxing, fine-tuning or closed models)
